justification: `docs/apidocs/com/google/zxing/common/package-summary.html` lists 16 top-level types in the package, and `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/common/*.java` totals about 3,900 LOC across files such as `BitArray.java` (359), `BitMatrix.java` (537), `HybridBinarizer.java` (237), `GlobalHistogramBinarizer.java` (203), `GridSampler.java` (174), `PerspectiveTransform.java` (156), `StringUtils.java` (262), and the ECI/decoder classes. The package concentrates several unrelated responsibilities: bit storage (`BitArray`, `BitMatrix`, `BitSource`), image binarization/sampling (`GlobalHistogramBinarizer`, `HybridBinarizer`, `GridSampler`, `DefaultGridSampler`), geometry (`PerspectiveTransform`), decode results (`DecoderResult`, `DetectorResult`), and charset/ECI handling (`CharacterSetECI`, `ECIInput`, `ECIEncoderSet`, `ECIStringBuilder`, `MinimalECIInput`), which is strong evidence of a God Component.
